metadata.title: Apple CEO John Ternus pay package: $58 million in fiscal 2027

content.text:
Apple disclosed the compensation package for new Chief Executive Officer John Ternus on Tuesday, his first day in the role: a $3 million annual salary and a targeted equity award of $55 million for fiscal 2027, bringing his total target compensation to approximately $58 million.
Apple's board People and Compensation Committee also awarded Ternus a prorated RSU grant with a target value of $2.5 million for his partial-year service as CEO in fiscal 2026, the company said. Performance-based RSUs account for three-quarters of his annual equity award, with vesting tied to how Apple's total shareholder return stacks up against the rest of the S&P 500. The other 25% comes in time-based RSUs, which vest every six months in equal 12.5% portions across a four-year period.
Apple also disclosed the compensation for Tim Cook in his new role as executive chairman. As executive chairman, Cook will earn a $2 million annual salary starting Sept. 26, along with a targeted equity award of $45 million for fiscal 2027, putting his total target compensation at roughly $47 million. Cook's equity is split evenly between performance-based RSUs benchmarked against the S&P 500 and time-based RSUs that follow the same semiannual vesting schedule as Ternus's. Cook's total pay package as CEO in 2025 was $74.3 million, according to Bloomberg. His salary is being reduced from $3 million in that prior role.
The filing left open the question of cash bonuses for both executives, according to The Wall Street Journal.
Ternus, 51, formally took over as Apple's chief executive on Tuesday, with Cook moving to executive chairman on the same date. Ternus joined Apple in 2001 and rose to senior vice president of hardware engineering in 2021, overseeing development of the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods, and Vision Pro. His first major product launch as CEO is scheduled for Sept. 9 at Apple's Cupertino, California campus, where the company is expected to unveil new iPhones, Apple Watches, and a rebuilt Siri voice assistant powered by large language models.
Cook sent a farewell memo to Apple employees on Monday, his final day as CEO. Apple announced the leadership transition in April following what it described as a long-term succession planning process. Cook grew Apple's market capitalization to $4 trillion during his 15-year tenure, with annual revenue climbing to more than $416 billion in fiscal year 2025.
